p: Represents a structure that defines an edge or border with measurements for each side: top, right, bottom, and left.
(float) = left: Gets a value representing the measurement of the left edge.
(float) = top: Gets a value representing the measurement of the top edge.
(float) = right: Gets a value representing the measurement of the right edge.
(float) = bottom: Gets a value representing the measurement of the bottom edge.
(float): Gets a value representing the combined measurement of the left and right edges.
(float): Gets a value representing the combination of the top and bottom edge measurements.
(Vector2): Gets a Vector2 representing the combination of the top and left edge measurements.
(Vector2): Gets a Vector2 representing the combination of the bottom and right edge measurements.
